notes.title: "One More Bang" Steam Next Fest Demo Big Update!
notes.content:
Hey fellow Bang players, we know you've been waiting! One More Bang is back for the Steam Next Fest, running from ​​June 09 to June 16, 2025 (PT)​​. To mark this event, we're rolling out another significant update! Just search ​​"One More Bang"​​ in the Steam Store to find the page and download the Demo.



If this is your first time trying our game, a big welcome! Remember, ​​this demo will remain playable even after the festival ends​​, so you can jump back in anytime.

​​About This Next Fest Demo (For Existing Demo Players):​

​
📢Here's the latest on what's new:
​​3D Gallery​ Adjustment​

​​2D Gallery​ Opening​

​​Match UI Adjustments & Optimizations​​

​​Reconnection Feature & Network Optimizations​​

​​Improved Beginner Tutorial & Key In-Game Information Display​​

​​Music & Sound Effect Optimizations​

​
​​✨Important Note for Demo Players:​​
Please be aware that ​​the game is still under development​​. While playing this demo version, you might encounter:

Events that feel difficult or impossible to complete.

Story dialogue/text that feels underdeveloped or too simplistic.

Missing translations or placeholder text.

Various other unfinished elements.

We appreciate your understanding regarding these aspects.


​​📝Feedback & Community:​​
You can report bugs or discuss the game's details with other enthusiasts by joining our ​​Official Discord: Join us on Discord​​ and send a screenshot of your review via private message to ​​"Tyrek"​​ or DM any of ​​Tide Game’s​​ social media accounts.

notes.title: "One More Bang" open Playtest 2.0 Sign Up Now
notes.content:
Dear Players,​​
After extensive adjustments and refinements, we’ve optimized the gameplay and UI!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536418/5bb97218f4c942f856a5e16c673f66cc0c4a8fbd.jpg

​​[The test is scheduled to begin this Wednesday]​​, and all interested players are welcome to Join us!
Let’s look at the updates below~

​​Gameplay Updates​​
​​= Victory Missions Remake=​​
Based on feedback from the last test, we’ve redesigned gameplay and updated role descriptions:

​​Heretic: Win by actively commit suicide during your own turn.

​​Butcher​​ (formerly ​​Demon​​): Win by personally eliminating two characters.

​​Magician​​ (formerly ​​Deity​​): Copy and complete the inspected character's victory mission.

​​Pharmacist​​ (formerly ​​Angel​​): After shooting ends during your turn, ensure all four characters' HP distinct and none at full health.


​​= Pharmacist Skill Rework =​​
Players found the original Angel/Deity mechanics unclear. With the new victory missions, the Angel’s skill no longer fits the play, so we’ve reworked the ​​Pharmacist​​’s skill:

​​Old Angel Skill​​: Protect a player from fatal damage for one reload round.
​​New Pharmacist Skill​​: Heal 1 HP to a selected player.

​​UI Updates​​
​​= "Nightfall" Animated Effects =​​
To enhance immersion, we’ve added dynamic animations to the ​​"Nightfall"​​ phase.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536418/eccd109d71160653e1589ef98142f9a87a0a6b49.gif

​​= Core Combat Interface Revamp =​​
The old UI no longer aligns with updated gameplay. We’ve overhauled combat displays for clearer information and simple interactivity!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536418/c182bdf0f4ba2a2df9a7a3b9a5461d34e8e5f272.jpg

​​Future Update Preview​​

Saori’s exclusive victory animation
New player tutorial rework
Main menu UI/background redesign
Sound effects & BGM upgrades
3D character atlas

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536418/0af396236816e95a566a645652c2b4c09d4ee4a0.jpg

And more to come...

notes.title: Notice to players: “One More Bang” closed playtest has ended!
notes.content:
Dear Players! 

"One More Bang" closed Playtest has ended! 

Due to the game servers being locally operated, overseas players experienced connection instability and occasional network packet loss.

We sincerely apologize for the server issues and regret that we were unable to accept all international player requests this time.

Our team is currently working to resolve server problems, ensuring stable operation for the upcoming demo.

The 'One More Bang' demo remains our top priority, which will be featured in Steam Next Fest starting July 9th.

The 'One More Bang' demo has been under review for the past month. Pending successful completion of this process, we intent releasing it within the next two weeks.

Additionally, we've implemented revised victory conditions for three roles (Demon/Deity/Angel), while maintaining the Heretic's existing winner.

[Original Victory Conditions]​​
Earn reward points by completing Hunting List missions, with final rankings determined by total points accumulated.

​​[Revised Victory Conditions]​​
Each role now possesses an exclusive victory condition.
If no roles fulfill their specific victory conditions, surviving until the end claims victory.

• ​​Heretic​​: Successfully end your own life
• ​​Demon​​: Personally eliminate two different characters
• ​​Deity​​: Inherit the victory condition of a verified role
• ​​Angel​​: Create four distinct health values among characters during your turn (no character at full HP)

This gameplay update will be implemented after concluding current playtests and will be available in the upcoming demo version.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461580

Sorry for Chinese UI. It is only a conception and we are keep working on it.

notes.title: About "One More Bang" Closed Playtest
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
​​Test Period:​​ May 7th to May 10th

Welcome you to join our playtest! We’re excited to hear your thoughts and feedback as you dive into the game. Let’s work together to make "One More Bang" even better!ːsteamhappyː

​​What We’re Looking For:​​
We want your honest opinions on: ​​UI interactions​​、​​Gameplay flow​​、​​Overall experience、​​Server stability​​ etc.  Your feedback will help us spot bugs, tweak systems, and polish the game before launch.ːsteamthumbsupː

​​About the Playtest Version:​​
This Playtest showcases the ​​core mechanics​​ of "One More Bang":

 Start with a ​​random identity​​ and Hunting List​​. 
 Use items and skills strategically to survive.
 Matches last ​​10-20 minutes​​ on average.
 Play at least ​​4 rounds​​ to unlock all current roles and items.

​​Note:​​ Only the ​​JK High School Girl (Saori)​​ is playable in this test. Other characters are coming later!

​​Important Notes:​​ːsteamthisː
This is a ​​work-in-progress build​​—expect bugs, crashes, and placeholder content. We’ll keep updating the test version, which might break save files or change systems. (Sorry, progress won’t carry over to the full game!)

​​Stuck?​​ If a button isn’t responding, tap ESC to back out.

​​Sharing content?​​ Need permission from the devs first (DM us!).

​​Found a bug?​​ Please report it via our Discord (link here). Join our Discord

About future planning?​​
After this test, we’ll add:

 ​​3 more characters​​: Vela, Nicky, and Isabelle.
 ​​Animated scenes​​ for all characters (lobby idle, identity checks, MVP moments, etc.).
 ​​Better music​​, smoother UI, and a ​​3D gallery​​ for unlocks.

Thanks for helping us shape "One More Bang"! Let’s make this awesome together. 💪
